senses.gloss: (b. h.; preced.) to be dry, to wither.
units: <cite ref="Beitzah 26b:18">Bets. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>מוקצה שי׳</he> stored fruits (v. <cite ref="M00596"><he>מוקצה</he></cite>) which were dry (on Friday), though the owner did not find it out until the Sabbath day; Y. ib. I, beg. 60ᵃ
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>עתיד … וליַיבֵּשׁ וכ׳</he> in the future a righteous man (Elijah) will come and lay the world dry (through want of rain).
